scientific_integrity: The closed-form two-cap lens is classical; the asserted finding is the full multiplicity distribution, duality and exact transition coefficients. The proof is analytic; numerical checks are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Only equal caps at the four fixed regular tetrahedron vertices on S^2; no result about optimality among variable center sets or random centers. Finite sampling does not prove the continuous theorem. An equivalent unindexed formula remains possible.
title: Exact coverage multiplicities and dual contact exponents of tetrahedral spherical caps
